rule: Biological opportunity, regulation, physical access, and private-release readiness are independent gates.

regulation_findings.finding: The reviewed 2026 guide controls current seasons; no historical closure was copied into the calibration.

city_access_gates.finding: Mears fishing pier and both navigation piers are covered; live park, wave, ice, barrier, and posted conditions control.
